_comment: Items where the operator's answer is ambiguous, is a question back to me, or contradicts another answer. Rendered with a yellow highlight and a reworded question. Operator-only file.

COMM-05.why: Answer asks me a question back ('what is MX') and proposes email instead.
COMM-05.q: Mail for 300x3.com has no MX record. (1) Accept that no mail is deliverable to the domain, or (2) set up a third-party mail relay? If (2), which provider?

COMM-07.why: Answer asks me what would be published - the scope is not stated.
COMM-07.q: Which specific content should go public: (a) the whole ALWAYS ON README, (b) only the item list and status, or (c) a separate short summary page? Publishing is one-way once the site is live.

COMM-06.why: Answer begins 'for what, updates?' - the confirmation is conditional.
COMM-06.q: Confirm: clone the most recent repository, and verify it against the running system? Or clone only, with no verification step?

OPS-07.why: Answer names a concept ('the default log and journal folder') but not a path.
OPS-07.q: Confirm the canonical journal root is /ALWAYSON/logs/ ? Should subdirectories such as operations/ and journal/ move under it, or stay where they are?

OPS-09.why: Answer asks how large a backup may be - a budget decision only you can set.
OPS-09.q: Set the retention budget: how many GB total, and over how many versions/days? I will size the restic prune policy to fit that.

OPS-11.why: Answer asks 'for what?' - the purpose of alerting is not stated.
OPS-11.q: Which failures should page you, and by what channel? Backup failure and disk above 80% are my default proposal; confirm or replace.

OPS-13.why: Answer asks 'for what?' - unclear whether this is still wanted.
OPS-13.q: Confirm linger should stay enabled for the systemd user services, so backups and monitoring survive logout and reboot.

OPS-14.why: Answer asks me to explain the difference rather than deciding.
OPS-14.q: I will write the explanation into the item and then apply the default. Confirm you want that, or tell me which store model you prefer.

PLAT-02.why: Answer asks 'of what?' - the scope of the matrix is not stated.
PLAT-02.q: Which versions should the matrix cover - only what is currently installed on this host, or also released versions we have not installed?

SEC-01.why: Answer contains two things: a question to me plus an instruction ('migrate the three').
SEC-01.q: Confirm the three databases to move to systemd credentials, and confirm whether KDE Wallet stores only the master keys while systemd holds the rest.

SIM-07.why: Answer is an instruction to me to find a link, not a decision. Nothing is unblocked yet.
SIM-07.q: Once I post the ROS 2 / Gazebo DDS documentation link, do you want the recommended DDS profile applied to the sim containers?

OPS-30.q: Off-site repo cannot exist until the OPS-09 budget is set and the pCloud entry from LEDGER-04 is filled in. Confirm you want me to wait on both.
